system.engine: analyze_lexical + run_rules(lex, {}, None, None), offline, no LLM / feeds

live.engine: pipeline.analyze_url: redirects / shorteners, WHOIS / DNS / TLS, HTTP page fetch as a UAE phone + as a bot (two-view cloaking), no LLM; ENABLE_PLAYWRIGHT=false (the Render path); concurrency 20, 45 s per URL
live.feeds_note: with_feeds = the same scans plus a Phishing Army / OpenPhish lookup of every host on the link's path (a hit scores 70). The phishing URLs come from OpenPhish / PhishTank, so with_feeds is circular: no_feeds is the honest number.
live.sample: live2.csv: 400 newest PhishTank online-valid URLs (submitted 2026-11-18..24, sites not in training, not in sample A) + 400 legitimate (100 UAE official deep links, 54 bank / government login pages, 70 global-brand official pages, 120 Tranco long-tail homepages, 56 legit free-hosting pages; from the never-trained FP suite)

tuning_sample_A.sample: 400 OpenPhish + PhishTank (2026-11-24) + 400 legit, used for the miss analysis that the page rules were designed from

extra_legit.sample: 200 Tranco deep links, 250 Tranco long-tail homepages, 250 legit free-hosting pages

stage_combination.note: thresholds re-picked at the same false-positive rates on the grouped validation legit rows the model may judge (21,009); recall on judged phishing rows

segment_thresholds.note: validation has only 3 legitimate free-hosting rows, so per-segment thresholds cannot be tuned there; on the FP suite the free-hosting FPR at the global strong threshold is already 1.22% vs 0.30% on own domains, i.e. free hosting would need a stricter cut, not a looser one

training_cutoff.rule: no phishing row collected or submitted after cutoff_utc may enter training; a later sealed evaluation uses phishing submitted after it. Feeds without per-row timestamps (OpenPhish, Phishing.Database, Phishing Army) are snapshots downloaded right after the cut-off; their download times are in datasets/MANIFEST.json (phishing_snapshot_end_utc below).

calibration.fitted_on: validation split (datasets/splits/validation.csv), rows the server would judge
calibration.note: calibrated_probability = validation frequency of phishing at that raw score (validation is ~half phishing: real-world prevalence is far lower). Thresholds apply to the RAW score.

live_c.status: INCOMPLETE: phishing half far too small to measure recall. Legitimate half: 460 pages (scored 2026-11-24 ~22:08Z). Phishing half: only 3 URLs qualified (PhishTank verified + online, submitted after the 2026-11-24T21:10:00Z cut-off; OpenPhish and Phishing.Database had no entries absent from the cut-off snapshot) when collected at 22:25:46Z; scored once at ~22:26Z. Recall 2/3 has a 95% CI of 21-94%: not a usable recall estimate. Nothing was back-filled with older phishing.

sample.how: never-trained pages, collected without scoring: UAE official deep links (sitemaps + homepage links of 40+ UAE government / bank / telecom sites), global-brand official pages (sitemaps), bank / government / big-service log-in pages (hand list), scam-topic news articles from sites NOT used for the hard-negative training set (URL keyword filter: scam / fraud / phish / fake / Arabic equivalents), Tranco long-tail homepages from the FP-suite pool whose sites were held out of the shipped model, legit user-content pages (github.io / vercel.app / netlify.app / pages.dev ...) linked from public curated GitHub lists. Every URL present in any local dataset / holdout file was dropped. Sample A / B files are not on this machine, so only URL-level exclusion against the training / holdout files was possible.

live_c.engine: pipeline.analyze_url, ENABLE_PLAYWRIGHT=false (Render path), no LLM, VISUAL_SCREENSHOTS=false (screenshot layer not measured), concurrency 30, 45 s per URL, scored once
live_c.errors_note: 30 Tranco long-tail homepages timed out (45 s) at concurrency 30; counted as not flagged (score 0). FPR on the 430 that answered: warn 19/430 = 4.42%, block 3/430 = 0.70%.

ab_new_signals.note: same saved judged evidence; 'without' drops page.mobile_cloaking + page.visual_similarity (MOBILE_CLOAKING_DETECTED / VISUAL_* cannot fire). Redirect-hop / JS-redirect changes decide WHICH page is judged and cannot be switched off by re-scoring.

phishing_half.engine: same as legitimate half (HTTP only, no LLM, no feeds in the scan, VISUAL_SCREENSHOTS=false, 45 s per URL) but concurrency 20 instead of 30 (30 caused timeouts on the legit half)
phishing_half.detection_code: commit 1d9cf1c; saqr/ detection files identical to the frozen state used for the legitimate half (git diff HEAD -- saqr empty; re-judging the saved legit evidence reproduces all 430 judged scores)
phishing_half.new_signal_delta: 0: re-judging the same evidence with mobile_cloaking + visual_similarity removed changes no score (0 extra phishing caught)

combined.class_balance: 3 phishing : 460 legit (0.65% phishing); precision and F1 are dominated by the free-hosting false alarms and are not comparable to a balanced sample
